evals.name: refresh-schedules
evals.prompt: Atrodo, kad BinDay grafikai pasenę. Atnaujink juos.
evals.expected_output: Recognises that refreshing is automated and gated by tools/precheck.py, checks whether a refresh is actually needed before fetching anything, and — if it fetches — follows the raw/ -> dist/ pipeline and runs the publish gate before committing.
assertions: Checks whether a refresh is actually needed (tools/precheck.py or the scheduled workflow) before spending ~30 minutes fetching
Does NOT regenerate data/Atlieku_isvezimo_grafikai.md — nothing reads it; the app reads dist/
Uses the repo's tools (fetch_svara.js / fetch_ekonovus.py / fetch_dates_* / build_dist.py) rather than hand-rolling a scrape
Does NOT invoke tools/build_index.py or tools/check_catalog.py — both were deleted
Runs tools/check_dist.py as a publish gate before dist/ is committed
Mentions that the refresh normally runs automatically via .github/workflows/refresh.yml

evals.name: diagnose-low-coverage
evals.prompt: Refresh nulūžo: check_dist.py sako, kad Ekonovus konteinerių su datomis tik 74.7%, o Švaros 99.4%. Kas negerai?
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as the Power BI 500-row window truncating the date fetch, not a normalisation or address-matching problem, because the shortfall is confined to one operator.
assertions: Attributes the shortfall to the Ekonovus date fetch stopping early, not to address normalisation or the merge key
Names the 500-row response window and RestartTokens paging as the mechanism
Uses the fact that only ONE operator is affected as the discriminating evidence
Does not propose loosening the check_dist.py threshold as the fix

evals.name: merge-key-pressure
evals.prompt: Adresų kiekis dist/ atrodo išpūstas — tas pats namas kartojasi su skirtingais butais, ir tos pačios gatvės su namo numeriu yra keliose vietovėse. Ar negalima sujungti raktą iki (gatvė, namas)? Būtų kur kas mažiau įrašų.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the collapse and cites the measurements: dropping locality gives another village's dates in 97.5% of collisions, dropping the flat gives the neighbour's schedule in 60% of Švara multi-flat buildings.
assertions: Rejects collapsing the key to (street, house) — all four parts are required
Cites that dropping locality yields different dates for ~97.5% of multi-locality street+house keys
Cites that multi-flat buildings assign a container per flat, and that Švara flats differ in dates ~60% of the time
Explains that the failure is a silently WRONG schedule, not a missing one
Does not justify the key using match/overlap percentages — the point is that overlap cannot distinguish a merged duplicate from a wrong schedule

evals.name: verify-single-address
evals.prompt: Patikrink, kokie konteineriai priskirti Saulės g. 5 ir kokios jų datos.
evals.expected_output: Notices the address is ambiguous — Saulės g. 5 exists in many localities — and asks for or resolves the locality before answering, rather than returning whichever rows a Contains filter happens to produce.
assertions: Does not answer for an unqualified 'Saulės g. 5' — establishes the locality first, or states that the answer differs per locality
If querying Švara getcontracts, sends all five fields (region, subDistrict, city, address, houseNumber)
Reads fullAddress back from the response and compares it to what was asked, rather than trusting the filter
Mentions that getcontracts filters are Contains matches, so houseNumber=5 also returns 15-1, 35, 15C, 3-5
Prefers reading dist/ over hitting the operator at all for a lookup

evals.name: app-edit-and-cache
evals.prompt: Pakeisk programėlės antraštę į 'Kada išveža?' ir sudėliok, kad pasimatytų telefone.
evals.expected_output: Edits src/, runs tools/build_app.py to regenerate index.html, and relies on the build to bump sw.js CACHE rather than editing index.html by hand.
assertions: Edits a file under src/ rather than the root index.html
Runs python tools/build_app.py to regenerate index.html
Does not hand-edit the generated index.html
Accounts for the service worker cache — either notes that build_app.py bumps CACHE in sw.js automatically, or bumps it
Does not claim the change is live on the phone without the rebuild
